description.text: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed into a cramped garage where the older mechanic leans over the open engine bay of a tired sedan. A low work lamp casts a warm pool over the block, while thin daylight leaks beneath the roll-up door and catches the dust in the air. The older mechanic, sleeves rolled to the elbow and hands dark with grease, jabs a finger toward a cracked drive belt threaded through the pulleys. Across the engine, the younger mechanic stands with a wrench held tight in one hand, his shoulders squared and his eyes fixed on the older man. The older mechanic breaks the silence and speaks without looking away from the belt; the younger man's jaw tightens, and his grip on the wrench shifts as he takes in the failed part. The engine ticks faintly as it cools. Tools clink somewhere on the bench, and the belt gives a small creak when the older man's finger presses near its split edge.
The older mechanic leans over the open engine bay in the cramped garage, one finger aimed at a cracked drive belt, while the younger mechanic stands opposite with a wrench.
A faint metallic tick rises from the cooling engine under soft garage room tone.
The older mechanic jabs toward the split belt as he speaks; the younger mechanic tightens his grip on the wrench.
A tool clinks against the bench and the cracked belt creaks.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The shot cuts to the younger mechanic, who lifts the cracked belt from the engine bay and turns it slowly in the light. The pale surface of the belt shows a dark split, and the younger man holds it up between himself and the older mechanic like evidence. His wrench rests against the engine block, no longer gripped for work. The older mechanic remains opposite him, a grease-stained hand braced on the fender, his gaze steady. As the younger mechanic answers back, his voice carries over the low room tone and the soft creak of the belt turning in his fingers. The work lamp glints along the belt's worn ribs, and the engine's metallic ticking fades under the sharper clink of a tool settling on the bench. The younger man keeps his eyes on the older man through the answer, then lowers the belt slightly, holding the moment at the edge of a decision.
The younger mechanic lifts the cracked belt and turns it in the work light while the older mechanic watches.
Garage room tone continues with a faint engine tick and a soft creak from the belt.
The younger mechanic answers while holding the older man's gaze and presenting the belt as evidence.
The belt creaks softly in his fingers as a tool settles on the bench.
The camera holds a static shot.
